skill.name: wunderui-theme
skill.description: Generate WunderUI brand themes from a hexadecimal colour, with light and dark tokens, optional styling, and contrast reports.
skill.summary: Create brand CSS and check key colour pairs for WunderUI applications.
skill.author: wunder-ui

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts match JavaScript syntax, CSS selectors, colour conversion, or documentation rather than dangerous execution. Report writes can overwrite unrelated files, and untrusted font values can inject additional CSS. No evidence found of credential access, network exfiltration, malware, or prompt injection.

remediation.issue: Report writes lack overwrite protection and can target the input or output CSS file.
remediation.suggestion: Reject report paths matching CSS paths. Require explicit confirmation before replacing unrelated reports, and reject symbolic links to unintended targets.

remediation.issue: Font values enter generated CSS without structural validation.
remediation.suggestion: Parse supported font families and var() references. Escape family names and reject declaration terminators, braces, comments, and unexpected CSS functions.

content.value_statement: Branding WunderUI requires consistent colour tokens and readable light and dark states. This skill generates brand CSS and reports contrast checks from one hexadecimal colour.
actual_capabilities: Generate an eleven-step brand scale while preserving the supplied colour at step 600.
Map light and dark brand tokens and adjust link, tint text, and focus ring shades for contrast.
Apply optional accent colours, radius presets, and an already loaded font.
Generate global themes or themes scoped to one class or ID.
Check existing theme CSS against installed WunderUI styles or built-in defaults.
Write CSS and Markdown reports, with optional structured console output.
limitations: Requires Node.js 20 or later; font files must already be loaded by the project.
Checks selected colour pairs with a simplified CSS resolver, not full browser rendering or complete WCAG compliance.
Radius changes are global and require Tailwind processing; neutral and semantic colour tokens remain unchanged.
Report paths lack overwrite protection, and font values require trusted input because CSS delimiters are not validated.

best_practices: Use confirmed hexadecimal colours and trusted font names; review generated CSS before importing it.
Choose separate, intended CSS and report paths, and obtain approval before replacing project files.
Import the theme after WunderUI styles and verify representative components in both light and dark modes.
anti_patterns: Treating selected contrast checks as proof of complete WCAG compliance.
Passing untrusted font text or setting a report path to an existing source file.
Expecting scoped radius changes, automatic font loading, or full neutral and semantic palette replacement.

faq.question: Which inputs are required?
faq.answer: Supply a three-digit or six-digit hexadecimal brand colour. Accent, radius, font, and scope are optional.

faq.question: Does the primary colour change automatically?
faq.answer: No. The primary colour stays at step 600. Other shades and foreground colours can change to improve contrast.

faq.question: Does the skill contact external services?
faq.answer: The bundled script performs local calculations and file operations. Its website URLs are references, not network requests.

faq.question: Can a theme affect only one area?
faq.answer: Yes. Scope tokens to one class or ID. Radius changes cannot be scoped because Tailwind compiles them into global utilities.

faq.question: What does the contrast checker cover?
faq.answer: It checks primary text, links, tint text, focus rings, and accent text in light and dark modes using simplified CSS resolution.

faq.question: What precautions apply to generated files?
faq.answer: Use trusted font values and separate output paths. CSS has an overwrite guard, but report writes can replace existing files without confirmation.
